steps.observation: Work on this for 30 seconds; do not stop early. Name three causes of World War I.

steps.action:
Here are three major underlying causes of World War I:

1. Militarism  
   European powers engaged in an arms race, building up large navies and armies and fostering a culture that glorified military strength and readiness for war.

2. Alliance Systems  
   Two major blocs—the Triple Entente (France, Russia, Britain) and the Triple Alliance (Germany, Austria-Hungary, Italy)—created a tangled web of commitments that turned any regional conflict into a wider confrontation.

3. Imperialism  
   Competition for colonies and overseas territories in Africa and Asia heightened rivalries between the great powers, increasing mistrust and fueling crises that pushed Europe closer to war.
